label: gym_koori_020_receptionist_01
text: Welcome to the Glaseado Gym! Would you like\nme to explain the rules of the Gym Test again?

label: gym_koori_020_receptionist_02
text: Here at the Glaseado Gym, we challenge you to\nattempt the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Snow Slope Run[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!

label: gym_koori_020_receptionist_03
text: Ride a Pokémon down the designated course\nand try to reach the goal within the time limit!

label: gym_koori_020_receptionist_04
text: To start your test, just head out of the Gym and\ngo up the slope to your left. We’ll fill you in on\r\nthe details there!

label: gym_koori_020_trainer_01
text: Hey there! I’ve been waiting for you. This is\nwhere the Snow Slope Run starts.

label: gym_koori_020_trainer_02
text: Your task is to ride a Pokémon all the way down\nthis course. It’s like a slippery, slidy nature trail!

label: gym_koori_020_trainer_03
text: Reach the finish line within the target time, and\nyou’ll have passed the test!

label: gym_koori_020_trainer_04
text: So! Ready to attempt the Gym Test by taking on\nthe Snow Slope Run?

label: gym_koori_020_trainer_05
text: Let’s get this test started, then! Enjoy the winter\nwonderland on your way down!

label: gym_koori_020_select_01
text: I’m ready to go!

label: gym_koori_020_select_02
text: Could you explain again?

label: gym_koori_020_select_03
text: I’m not ready yet...

label: gym_koori_020_trainer_06
text: Congratulations on completing the run!\c\nThat was some of the best sliding I’ve ever seen!\nAlmost like seeing Grusha in his prime again...

label: gym_koori_020_system_01
text: Oh, you obviously passed the Gym Test with\nflying colors. Go let the receptionist know!

label: gym_koori_020_trainer_07
text: I hate to say it, but that run was a failure...\nI’m just glad you’re not hurt!

label: gym_koori_020_trainer_08
text: Don’t worry, though. You can attempt a Gym Test\nas many times as you want. Don’t give up!\r\nCome back when you’re ready!
